_comment: RoadAware backend data-foundation config. Relative paths resolve against the backend root (the folder containing config/). Env overrides: ROADAWARE_SOURCE_DIR (raw source folder), ROADAWARE_OUTPUT_DIR (root for data/ and reports/), ROADAWARE_BACKEND_ROOT (backend folder).
source_scope_note: MOT road-network accident records; not all roads in Thailand.

blocked_feature_groups.historical_lags: blocked until reporting delay / availability at issue time is proven
blocked_feature_groups.weather_era5_target_day: blocked; target-day reanalysis is not available at issue time
blocked_feature_groups.holidays: pending an approved Thai holiday calendar source

possibly_undercounted_policy: Every quarantined or no-ID diagnostic row flags (province, candidate date) for each candidate date (both D/M and M/D for ambiguous slash dates; the parsed date when only time/coords/ID failed). Missing province flags that date for all provinces. Flagged province-days have training_eligible = false. Flags and eligibility are audit columns, never features.
provisional_decisions: Train 2021-2023, Validation 2024, reused_test_2025 (seen previously), diagnostic_2026 (no ACC_CODE; never a label).
Daily province-level recorded-count target issued 18:00 Asia/Bangkok on the previous day (data-readiness demo only, not the route model).
Ambiguous slash dates (D/M vs M/D both valid and different) are quarantined, not resolved; both candidate province-days are flagged possibly_undercounted.
Rows with invalid time, invalid/outside coordinates, missing province or conflicting IDs are conservatively excluded even if their date is known; their candidate days are flagged.
Coordinates checked against a broad Thailand bounding box only.
unresolved_blockers: Ambiguous slash-date convention per file is not confirmed by the publisher.
Reporting delay and data availability at issue time are unknown (lags blocked).
Coverage: MOT road network only; completeness of recorded events unknown; zero means no selected recorded event.
Other unknown reporting issues (late entries, unrecorded events, edits) may remain beyond the flagged province-days.
Reported province is not verified against coordinates.
2025 data was previously inspected; no untouched independent test exists.
2569 file lacks ACC_CODE so events cannot be de-duplicated by ID.
Final spatial unit (route segment) and forecast horizon not agreed.
